br_ska_01: [serious] On the 14th of October at 04:40 AM local, the Chinese crossed into Nepal.
br_ska_02: [short pause] Along the border into Humla.
br_ska_03: Hilsa, Yari and Limi are lost and the Nepal Army positions have been overrun.
br_ska_04: [inhales deeply] As per intelligence, their columns are advancing down the Karnali gorge...
br_ska_05: ...by their trajectory it looks like Simikot is next.
br_ska_06: The Nepalese garrisons are holding above Kermi, but they're no match for the Chinese.
br_ska_07: [short pause] They've lost a lot of men. They only have two days of food and even less ammunition.
br_ska_08: [thoughtful] On the request of the Nepalese military we have decided to assist with a supply drop. You'll be flying a C-17 to the Simikot airstrip.
br_ska_09: It is an extremely short runway, so you'll be performing a very low altitude airdrop of food, munitions and medical supplies.
br_ska_10: [serious] Intel has confirmed there are no surface-to-air launchers in the convoy, however... beware of portable MANPADS systems.
br_ska_11: We cannot let Simikot fall into Chinese hands at any cost.
